author: high
claim: Prove the target equivalence by alternating bipartition classes around cycles in the forward direction and coloring each component by rooted spanning-tree depth parity in the reverse direction.
evidence: The forward implication is definitional. In the reverse implication, a same-parity edge closes the unique even-length tree path between its endpoints into a simple odd cycle.

glossary.G: the finite undirected graph in the theorem
glossary.A: one vertex class in a bipartition
glossary.B: the other vertex class in a bipartition
glossary.T: a spanning tree of a connected component of G
glossary.r: a chosen root vertex of T
glossary.d_T(r,v): the number of edges on the unique path in T from r to v
